description: Row grammar of the operator standing-rulings record: an index over operator-answers-history.md. Read by standing-rulings.sh; no second copy exists.

proposal_marker.note: the proposing question text (answers kind) or the DP entry's Decision/Question line (decision kind) carries prefix + the row's match EXACTLY + class_prefix + a class; the match ends where class_prefix begins
proposal_marker.outside_note: the classes of Rule 11(a)'s sort Outside list; a proposal naming one never becomes a row, and a proposal naming no class or an unknown one never becomes a row

ruling.note: the operator's answer, verbatim; sha256 of it must equal the SHA256 line of the cited entry

source.note: the line number of the entry heading `## <ts> -- AskUserQuestion`
source.alt_note: the heading line of a requests-history entry carrying `- Pending decision: DP-...`; the typed message is the ruling verbatim

forbidden_matches.name: update-re-approval
forbidden_matches.anchor: Re-approve the reconcile report for this pull?
